visual_review: 0045 retains the strongest silver-hair, purple-eye, gold-glasses identity at the approved 70 percent authored scale.
No scalp gap, front-hair/face tear, glasses-layer inversion, butterfly orbit, old combined head fragment, or canvas clipping was observed in the 120 standard samples.

The weighted 0045 branch changes rendered pixels while remaining visually subtle at gameplay scale; it showed no visible seam in idle, relaxed, low-health, attack, heavy, cast, hurt, or pre-swap death samples.
0044 is more compact but materially weakens face and glasses readability at gameplay scale.
